HTML comment ending with ---> (three dashes) must not drop content that follows (issue #339)

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<h1>One</h1>\n<!-- /// --->\n<p>Two</p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result)
```
